HII’s Newport News Shipbuilding is hiring a Software Development Engineer 1 to develop and maintain software and analytical solutions for U.S. Navy, Department of Energy, and industrial/manufacturing customers. The role supports software development, simulation, analytics, and visualization products across the product development lifecycle, working with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment.

Responsibilities
Develops new and/or integrates existing system simulation frameworks, performance models and algorithms, threat models and command and control models
Simulates real-time operations and develops software that simulates behavior of systems
Develops integrates and uses advanced graphical user interfaces and visualization tools
Models operational environments, performs trade studies via computer simulation and recommends alternative architectures
Performs operational analysis and mission effectiveness analysis
As a Software Developer, you will have technical responsibilities involving the research, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance evolutions of the product development lifecycle for software solutions
Working in an Agile environment, you will work closely with a variety of roles including software developers, data analysts, subject matter experts, and customers to determine and implement best solutions
